articles.title: ZenteiQ scales batch inference 4x with GKE Inference Gateway powered by llm-d
articles.text:
Today we hear from ZenteiQ, an artificial intelligence startup spun out of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) and selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build sovereign scientific foundation models from the ground up. To pre-train models that understand physical laws, governing equations, and numerical solvers, ZenteiQ designed and built a large-scale batch synthetic data-generation pipeline that runs across multiple model families and feeds verified datasets into training runs. Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) and GKE Inference Gateway gave ZenteiQ the inference-routing layer within its pipeline to scale aggregate inference throughput 4.07x and grow daily output from 1.47 billion to 5.97 billion generated tokens for every 1,000 accelerators. - Fisayo Feyisetan, Product Manager, Google Cloud
Unlike general-purpose language models trained primarily on web text and code, scientific foundation models must understand complex physical systems, mathematical governing equations, and numerical solvers across domains such as thermodynamics, computational fluid dynamics, and electromagnetics. At ZenteiQ, we are building sovereign scientific foundation models from scratch that interpret simulation outputs, evaluate equation formulations, and work through step-by-step mathematical derivations that obey physical laws.
Pre-training models on large datasets of governing equations takes hundreds of billions of reasoning tokens. Alongside curated scientific literature and simulation datasets, we also rely on a batch synthetic data-generation pipeline that we independently designed and implemented to generate, evaluate, and filter candidate derivations and solver validation problems before feeding them into our MaxText pre-training jobs.
Because we operate on a fixed compute allocation, every hour our accelerators spend generating and verifying training data is an hour taken away from pre-training. When data generation falls behind, multi-host accelerator clusters reserved for pre-training sit idle, waiting on datasets.
When data generation slows down pre-training
To maximize data generation speed, our pipeline separates prompt preparation on worker pods from model serving on vLLM across multi-node accelerator pools. Each batch moves through four stages: expanding scientific seed concepts into prompt batches, generating candidate reasoning traces with generator models, scoring responses using evaluator models, and running guardrail checks with a separate model family before packaging verified datasets for pre-training.
We originally ran these model pools on Kubernetes with standard ClusterIP round-robin load balancing across inference endpoints. As we scaled our pipeline to feed our 9B- and 35B-parameter model schedules, two routing bottlenecks began slowing down dataset creation.
Uneven engine queues: Our upstream worker pods expand seed concepts into prompts of widely varying complexity and response length. Because standard round-robin load balancing had no visibility into vLLM engine queues, it kept sending new requests to serving pods that were already busy processing long reasoning traces, while neighboring nodes had capacity to spare.
Redundant prefix computation: Prompts within a generation batch share roughly 70% to 80% of their instructional context and task specifications. Round-robin routing scattered requests with identical instructions across different serving instances, forcing each pod to recompute the same shared prompt prefix from scratch instead of reusing warm caches in accelerator memory.
Together, uneven queues and redundant prefill work caused our generation throughput to swing by as much as half within a single run, stretching out dataset creation and delaying the start of scheduled pre-training runs. We needed routing that understood live vLLM queue depths and prompt caches, without pulling our researchers off model development to build and maintain a custom inference scheduler.
Building on GKE Inference Gateway powered by llm-d
We already run our data preparation and MaxText pre-training jobs on GKE, which lets our team manage data generation and model training on the same Kubernetes platform. Following a recommendation from Google Cloud to address our routing bottlenecks without changing our underlying scientific methodology or pipeline design, we deployed GKE Inference Gateway, powered by the open-source llm-d distributed inference framework, in front of our vLLM accelerator pools.
In our pipeline, worker pods pull scientific seed documents and domain taxonomies from Cloud Storage and expand them into batches of multi-step prompts. Those batches flow through a single GKE Inference Gateway deployment that manages traffic across all of our model families and serving nodes.
Rather than maintaining isolated routing for each model tier, we route generation requests, evaluation queries, and guardrail checks across their respective model pools through the same gateway. Once candidate responses pass evaluation and guardrail checks, worker pods deduplicate and package the verified datasets for direct consumption by downstream MaxText pre-training jobs on GKE.
GKE Inference Gateway routes batch generation, evaluation, and guardrail requests across multi-node accelerator pools running vLLM before verified datasets are fed into MaxText pre-training.
From round-robin to load- and cache-aware routing
With GKE Inference Gateway and llm-d, routing decisions use live serving signals from our vLLM instances rather than static round-robin rotation. GKE Inference Gateway continuously monitors real-time queue depth and key-value (KV) cache utilization across our vLLM endpoints. When a serving node is busy decoding a long equation derivation, the gateway routes incoming requests to nodes with open capacity, so heavy prompts no longer pile up behind busy workers while neighboring nodes sit idle.
At the same time, the gateway routes requests with matching scientific instructions to the serving node where that prefix’s KV cache is already warm in accelerator memory. Because 70% to 80% of each prompt is shared instructional context while the generated reasoning trajectories vary from request to request, combining prefix-cache locality with live queue balancing lets our pods skip repeated prefill work without overloading any single replica.
Higher throughput, predictable training runs
Adopting GKE Inference Gateway powered by llm-d transformed the speed and predictability of our data generation pipeline. Across our production clusters, intelligent routing delivered:
4x higher fleet throughput: Aggregate throughput jumped from 16,964 to 69,114 tokens per second per 1,000 accelerators — growing daily output from 1.47 billion to nearly 6 billion generated tokens.
3.5x to 5.5x gains across individual model pools: Real-time queue balancing kept serving nodes evenly loaded throughout each run, preventing the mid-run slowdowns caused by long reasoning derivations.
14-percentage-point higher prefix-cache hit rate: Routing prompts with matching scientific instructions to warm caches avoided redundant prefill work before each request branched into its own derivation.
For our research and infrastructure teams, the most important outcome was schedule predictability. Quadrupling daily output meant verified datasets were ready on time, so our multi-host pre-training runs started on schedule instead of waiting on data generation.
What’s next for physical AI at ZenteiQ
As we scale our scientific foundation models from 9B to 35B parameters and beyond, we plan to use the same GKE Inference Gateway and llm-d routing setup for post-training reinforcement learning (RL) and automated numerical solver evaluation loops. Because each turn in those multi-turn rollouts builds on the context of the turns before it, they depend even more heavily on live queue balancing and warm prefix caches.
To try these capabilities on your own workloads, explore the GKE Inference Gateway documentation and check out the open-source llm-d project. You can also read how the Gemini platform team cut latency by 35% with GKE Inference Gateway.

articles.title: Visa 发布三项商业支付能力：开启 AI 智能体支付试点，预测 B2B 虚拟卡价值 2029 年将达 14.6 万亿美元
articles.text:
IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，Visa 今日宣布推出三项面向商业支付的新能力，分别指向商业卡增长、虚拟卡安全与 AI 支付。
这三项举措共同的前提是：企业支付自动化的瓶颈正在从“能否完成交易”，转向“每一笔由系统或 AI 智能体发起的交易能否被识别、授权和管控”。
第一项是 SESA 2.0，即供应商启用支出分析平台的第二代版本。该平台建立在 Visa 过去四年帮助金融机构评估供应商支付机会的经验之上，将 AI 供应商评分、Visa 商业支付数据、买方基准和商业价值建模整合在一起，用于判断哪些供应商更可能接受商业卡支付，并估算潜在的商业卡增长空间。据 Visa 介绍，SESA 平台自推出以来已帮助金融机构识别出超过 6,000 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 4.01 万亿元人民币）的潜在可刷卡支出。
第二项是 Visa Commercial Fraud Solutions，这是一套覆盖商业支付三个阶段的欺诈防控工具。在支付前，Commercial Supplier Validation 用于验证资金确实流向预期供应商；在认证环节，Commercial Virtual Authentication 通过 3-D Secure 对商业虚拟卡用户进行身份验证；在授权前，Commercial Payment Controls 允许企业在交易层面设置支出金额、商户类别、地点和时间等限制。三项能力中，Payment Controls 已在符合条件的国家和地区向合格的发卡机构可用，而 Virtual Authentication 和 Supplier Validation 目前处于试点阶段，预计 2027 年全面可用。
Visa 介绍称，Juniper Research 的研究显示，全球 B2B 虚拟卡支付价值预计到 2029 年达到 14.6 万亿美元（现汇率约合 97.69 万亿元人民币），占全球虚拟卡市场总值的 83%。虚拟卡在 B2B 场景中的优势 —— 单笔单卡、额度可控、数据可追溯 —— 同时也是欺诈防控的难点：卡号在自动化流程中流转，一旦验证环节失效，资金可能流向未经核实的供应商或账户。Visa Commercial Fraud Solutions 的定位，正是将“供应商是否真实”“使用者是否为授权方”“交易是否在预设边界内”这三个问题嵌入授权前的决策链路。
第三项是 Visa 与 BILL、Billtrust 共同启动的实时 AI 智能体支付试点。根据三方公告，这是首个让可信 AI 智能体端到端发起并完成已审批买方发票支付的实时试点。此前，许多供应商门户依赖人工认证，限制了已审批支付被自动化的程度；BILL 的支付智能体通过 Visa Trusted Agent Protocol 和 Agentic Directory 完成注册，使用代币化支付凭证和与买方审批指令对齐的控制项，代表 BILL 客户发起支付；Billtrust 则利用同一协议识别并认证该智能体，授予其门户访问权限，从而在不共享供应商门户登录凭证的情况下完成支付。这套机制还可以满足门户历史上由 CAPTCHA 等反机器人措施承担的站点保护功能，而不需要额外登录。
Visa 表示，这一试点的关键不在于“AI 能否发起支付”，而在于“AI 智能体的身份和行为能否被独立验证”。Visa 的 Trusted Agent Protocol 用于确立智能体身份、确认其被授权代表特定买方行事，并将交易绑定到具体发票和买方审批指令；代币化凭证替代了共享登录，使供应商门户不必将访问权限交给一个无法问责的自动化流程。Billtrust 高级副总裁 Kunal Patel 的表述是，智能体式商业取决于企业能否以“对人员同样的清晰度和问责制”来信任跨系统运行的智能体。目前该试点已在参与方的 BILL 买方和 Billtrust 供应商之间处理端到端交易，但尚属有限范围的实时测试，而非规模化商用。

articles.title: From Last-Layer to Cross-Layer: One-Shot Joint Classifier Reconstruction for Federated Learning
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.26953v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training while preserving data privacy. However, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data inevitably introduces classifier bias, leading to significant performance degradation. Existing studies primarily focus on calibrating or reconstructing the classifier after FL training to alleviate this bias. We find that the last-layer representations of the global model are often suboptimal for establishing a global decision boundary. Instead, classifiers constructed based on intermediate-layer representations can achieve superior performance. This finding provides a critical insight into overcoming the performance bottleneck inherent in existing paradigms. Nevertheless, identifying the optimal layer without auxiliary datasets or prior knowledge remains a formidable challenge. In this paper, we propose FLARE (Federated Cross-Layer Joint ClAssifier REconstruction) which rethinks classifier reconstruction from a cross-layer perspective and generalizes ridge regression to jointly exploit cross-layer representations, thereby surpassing the performance of any individual layer. Specifically, after FL training, clients perform only a single forward pass to extract class-conditional statistics from predefined layers. The server aggregates these statistics to construct a joint cross-layer ridge classifier, where an adaptive coupling coefficient regulates cross-layer correlations, thereby facilitating the integration of complementary discriminative information. Extensive experiments across 11 datasets, 8 model architectures, and diverse data heterogeneity scenarios demonstrate that FLARE, as a plug-and-play post-processing method, improves accuracy by 11.35% with only one additional communication round.

articles.title: EviDial: When Correct Depression Predictions Lack Evidence
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27541v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Depression dialogue benchmarks commonly assess models by comparing predicted symptom labels with clinical scale scores. However, a prediction may agree with a benchmark label even when the dialogue lacks enough evidence to justify it. We introduce EviDial, a benchmark that distinguishes label agreement from evidence-grounded assessment. EviDial comprises 382 depression dialogues from three sources and 2,744 participant-symptom cells, each classified as having absent, partial, conflicting, or sufficient evidence. Because evidence sufficiency lacks a directly observable gold standard, we derive calibrated evidence references from multiple judgments using generalizability theory, many-facet Rasch measurement, and random-effects latent class analysis. Our audit reveals that 82.8% of participant-symptom cells lack sufficient textual evidence for the corresponding symptom assessment, with substantial variation across sources. Across model families and prompting strategies, 69.2%-96.9% of predictions judged correct by benchmark labels are nonetheless unsupported by sufficient dialogue evidence. Further analyses show that strong agreement among LLM evaluators need not reflect independent evidence judgments, underscoring the need to calibrate automated reference panels. These findings demonstrate that label-based evaluation can overestimate evidence-grounded performance by conflating agreement with clinical labels and support in the observed dialogue. EviDial provides a measurement layer for separating these constructs and auditing LLM-based depression assessment more faithfully.

articles.title: Intel installs production tools at Fab 62 in Arizona, provides updates on Ohio chip fab
articles.text:
Intel on Wednesday announced that it had started installing production tools at its Fab 62 in Arizona, and the fab is on track for mass production by late 2028. The company also reported progress on its Ohio One manufacturing complex and confirmed that it has integrated High-NA EUV lithography into high-volume manufacturing (HVM). Meanwhile, Intel continues to invest in its leading-edge process technology R&D, advanced packaging, and photomask production capabilities in the U.S., which puts the company ahead of the competition.
"There is an important difference between technologies made in America and technologies that are truly American-made," wrote Naga Chandrasekaran, executive vice president and chief technology and operations officer, Intel Foundry. "The difference lies in the research and development process that transforms ideas into manufacturable technologies."
Fab 62 to begin operations in 2028
Intel completed construction of its Fab 62 shell some time ago; now it is time for the company to begin installing production tools, which is what it is doing now. Intel expects the new facility to become operational before the end of 2028, although it has not disclosed when it intends to begin high-volume production or which nodes it will produce.
(Image credit: Intel)
Intel has not officially assigned Intel 14A to Fab 62, although the facility has been discussed as a potential manufacturing site for the node. Meanwhile, there is an important distinction between Intel's original plans for Fab 62 and its current commitments. When Intel announced Fab 52 and Fab 62 in Arizona, it said the two facilities would manufacture its most advanced process technologies, including Intel 20A (2nm-class) and 18A (1.8nm-class). Intel subsequently designated Fab 52 for Intel 18A manufacturing. Yet, Fab 62 remains unassigned.
Given Intel's manufacturing process roadmap disclosed earlier this year, Fab 62 will be able to make chips on 18A, 18A-P, and 14A nodes. Intel currently manufactures Intel 18A chips at the neighboring Fab 52, whereas Fab 62 could potentially accommodate either additional Intel 18A capacity or the company’s next-generation Intel 14A process technology. However, Intel has yet to confirm its plans for the facility.
The facility will become Intel's Fab 62, the sixth high-volume semiconductor manufacturing fab at its Ocotillo campus, which has served as one of the company’s primary production sites for decades.
Intel has also not revealed Fab 62's planned wafer processing capacity, or the amount of capital expenditures required to complete the facility. Nevertheless, the installation of production equipment indicates that the project has progressed beyond construction of the building itself. The new fab will expand Intel’s manufacturing footprint in Arizona, where the company already produces leading-edge processors and operates advanced packaging, assembly, and testing facilities.
Intel confirms High-NA EUV insertion into mass production
Another noteworthy disclosure concerns Intel's deployment of High-NA EUV lithography. Intel was the first chipmaker to install a commercial High-NA EUV scanner at its D1X fab near Hillsboro, Oregon, and subsequently integrated the tool into high-volume manufacturing to produce its Panther Lake and other chips.
The Gordon Moore Park at Ronler Acres in Oregon is where Intel develops its most advanced logic process technologies and initiates volume production of the latest processors. Usage of High-NA EUV to produce select tiles for Panther Lake CPUs at D1X is a natural fit for the development fab, as it helps Intel to better understand how these lithography systems work. Meanwhile, it seems (though Intel has not explicitly confirmed) that, for now, High-NA EUV scanners are used to produce the same circuits as Low-NA EUV machines, so the use of next-generation lithography systems does not necessarily provide significant advantages over existing litho scanners.
Ohio One reaches another construction milestone
Intel has also made progress with its 'Ohio One' manufacturing complex in New Albany, Ohio. Construction workers recently installed the first major structural truss at the site's first semiconductor fab, which represents a milestone in the development of the company's manufacturing operations in the state. The project is clearly an important part of Intel's long-term strategy to expand domestic production of chips using leading-edge process technologies for years to come.
(Image credit: Intel)
Unfortunately, Intel did not provide an updated construction schedule for Ohio One or disclose when the first fab is expected to begin operations. Intel also did not reveal which process technology the facility will eventually use or the estimated manufacturing capacity it will provide. Therefore, while construction continues, which is good news, the announcement does not clarify exactly when Ohio One will contribute to Intel's output.
Other investments across the U.S.
In addition to leading-edge manufacturing capacity in the U.S., Intel continues to invest in advanced packaging technologies. Oregon serves as the company's main research and development center for advanced logic and 3D interconnect technologies, while Arizona hosts advanced packaging R&D, assembly, and testing operations. Intel uses its site in New Mexico to produce its complex multi-chiplet processors relying on advanced packaging methods — starting with modest EMIB and all the way to next-generation EMIB-T and Foveros technologies.
(Image credit: Intel)
Also, Intel recently broke ground on a new photomask manufacturing facility in Santa Clara, California. The new facility will be an important part of Intel's supply chain in the U.S., as the company will be the only chipmaker in America to develop and produce chips using leading-edge nodes completely in the U.S. (both Samsung and TSMC currently lack leading-edge process R&D in America; they do not run their own photomask shops in the U.S., and Samsung has abandoned its plan to build an advanced packaging facility in Texas). Of course, Intel critically depends on tools from Europe and materials from Japan, but even as its major rivals invest hundreds of billions in their U.S. production capacity, Intel remains ahead.
To highlight its American supply chain, Intel disclosed that its U.S. operations involve more than 4,500 suppliers across 49 states, as its annual domestic expenditures exceed $29 billion. The company stressed that domestic semiconductor leadership requires not only wafer fabrication capacity but also research, process development, advanced packaging, and a comprehensive supply chain.

articles.title: On the LLM Verification for Argument Graph Generation
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27361v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems can formalize natural-language argumentation end-to-end, turning plain text into structured graphs by classifying components, connecting them with relations, and enriching the resulting graphs into formal models. Quality assurance for those graphs is almost always another LLMs: a reviewer, judge, or critic agent. On the other side, in adjacent neuro-symbolic fields, such generated output is often verified symbolically by external checks and solvers. In this work, we argue that in argument graph verification, the allocation should be similar, and based on what each instrument can guarantee. We propose layered verification: starting from deterministic checks, moving to solver-based and LLM reviews, and utilizing debate only under uncertainty, leaving human judgment for what no other instrument can decide. We ground our principle with a study on human-annotated graphs with injected structural defects. An LLM reviewer detects them at near-ceiling recall, including cycles in the support relation, but it objects to almost one in a ten correct graphs, even though it should not, happens to be inconsistent in verdict on identical inputs and is significantly slower than the equivalent exact check. It shows that while LLM reviewer does not lack the ability to detect structural defects, it is worth having a deterministic verification gates.

articles.title: Responding to core PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619
articles.text:
Editor's note: This blog was updated on Oct. 22, 2026 at 9:25 a.m. PDT, with revised guidance on Cloud Armor, and on Oct. 21, 2026, with additional guidance on monitoring, patching, and remediation.
PHP and Wiz Research disclosed today two critical vulnerabilities in the core PHP language runtime that can expose applications to unauthenticated remote code execution and memory disclosure. Wiz used a mix of models to identify and help remediate these vulnerabilities.
Notably, Gemini 4 Argon made an invaluable contribution to finding the vulnerability, exploit development, attack detection, and validation of the patch.
While Google Cloud itself is not vulnerable, users of PHP running on Google Cloud may be vulnerable. At Google Cloud, we understand the severity of these vulnerabilities, and are sharing guidance to help our customers take immediate action to secure their applications.
Vulnerability background
PHP is a widely-used, server-side scripting language that powers many websites, content management systems, and web applications. On Oct. 21, 2026, CVE.org assigned the vulnerabilities as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.
The official Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base severity score for each of the PHP flaws has been determined as Critical, a severity of 9.2. Generally, this ranking means that threat actors can crash and hijack the affected system, and can easily steal, alter, and wipe its data — although mitigating circumstances can make it harder to exploit the flaw.
CVE-2026-109618: Out-of-memory handling can interrupt PHP while internal request data is only partially initialized. Request cleanup may then treat the invalid data as valid.
CVE-2026-109619: Request-owned internal state can survive after its backing memory has been freed. A later request handled by the same worker may use that stale state before normal initialization resets it.
Vulnerable versions: All versions of PHP from 5.4 through 8.5.11
Patched in: PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35
Not patched: The PHP project is not releasing fixes for PHP 8.1 or earlier, which have reached end of life.
Fix: CVE-2026-109618 (GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w) and CVE-2026-109619 (GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp):
Announcement: PHP has published a security advisory on these two vulnerabilities.
Wiz Research has published a detailed description of the research and the coordinated disclosure process.
Update PHP and redeploy your applications
We urge all customers running PHP applications on Google Cloud to immediately update to PHP 8.2 or newer, and redeploy their services using a patched version.
This applies specifically to applications deployed on:
App Engine standard environment: Supported runtimes are patched automatically. If you are on PHP 8.1 or earlier, upgrade to PHP 8.2 or newer and redeploy.
App Engine flexible environment: Redeploy your PHP runtimes using a supported runtime. If you are using a custom runtime, update your PHP dependencies to a patched version and redeploy your application.
Cloud Run: If automatic base image updates are not enabled, or you deploy your own container image, rebuild with a patched version of PHP and redeploy.
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Update your container images with a patched version of PHP and redeploy your pods.
Google Cloud Marketplace: If you run a Marketplace solution that includes PHP, such as a content management system or LAMP stack, apply the update from the solution provider or update PHP directly.
Automatic patches for serverless platforms
Google Cloud is rolling out updated serverless base images for all supported PHP versions on App Engine Standard, App Engine Flexible, Cloud Run, Cloud Run function, and Cloud Functions for Firebase.
What this means for you:
App Engine standard environment (PHP 8.2 and newer): Applications are updated automatically. No action is required.
App Engine flexible environment (all PHP versions): Applications are not updated automatically. Redeploy your application as soon as possible to PHP 8.2 and newer.
Cloud Run functions (PHP 8.2 and newer): Functions with automatic base image updates enabled are updated automatically. Functions without automatic base image updates enabled must be redeployed.
Cloud Run (PHP 8.2 and newer): Services with automatic base image updates enabled are updated automatically. Services built without automatic base image updates must be rebuilt and redeployed to pick up the patched runtime.
Important considerations:
Unsupported runtimes will not be patched. The upstream PHP project is not backporting these fixes to PHP 8.1 or earlier. Applications on PHP 5.5, PHP 7.2, PHP 7.3, PHP 7.4, or PHP 8.1 remain vulnerable and must be upgraded to PHP 8.2 or newer. See the following runtime support schedules for serverless lifecycle dates:
Google App Engine Standard
Google App Engine Flexible
Cloud Run
Cloud Run functions
Container images you build yourself are your responsibility. If you have deployed your own container image to Cloud Run or App Engine Flexible (such as with a custom runtime), rebuild it with a patched version of PHP and redeploy.
Mitigating CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 with Cloud Armor
Cloud Armor has issued recommended mitigations that use Cloud Armor managed rules. Customers with active managed rules do not need to take action; protection against these vulnerabilities is applied automatically.
If you have not yet deployed Cloud Armor managed rules, doing so now can still help you mitigate these vulnerabilities. The Cloud Armor managed rules protections are available now through automatically-updated threat intelligence rulesets.
These rules are intended to help protect your internet-facing PHP applications and services that use global or regional application load balancers. Follow these steps to deploy the rules immediately as a frontline defense-in-depth mitigation while your vulnerability management program updates and verifies all vulnerable PHP instances in your environment.
1. Deploying stable managed rules in enforce mode for automatic updates:
To protect your workloads, follow this guide to enable the File Upload and RFI categories. We recommend that you configure all ruleset categories in the stable version in enforced mode.
2. Mitigate risk on request bodies that exceed configured inspection limits:
Create a rule in your security policies to help ensure that no uninspected or unnecessarily large content reaches your backends. This is important for these CVEs, because threat actors may use large payloads to trigger out-of-memory conditions.
Verifying WAF rule safety for your application and consuming telemetry
Consult our Cloud Armor best practices guide and accounting for service limitations to minimize risk and optimize performance.
Cloud Armor mitigations serve solely as compensating controls in your layered defense to reduce immediate exposure. Upgrading PHP to a fixed version and redeploying services is required to fully resolve these vulnerabilities.
Monitoring and auditing
Google Cloud and Wiz are currently supporting customers with active monitoring, auditing, and runtime detection across its native security offerings. Customers can use:
On-Demand Scanning API to manually scan images stored locally on your computer or remotely in Artifact Registry. Customers using Artifact Analysis will be notified of these vulnerabilities on both new and existing artifacts to identify at-risk workloads.
Security Command Center to enable container threat detection for GKE and Cloud Run threat detection to monitor their workloads for intrusions.
Google Security Operations now has 23 new curated detections added to the Mandiant Frontline Threats rule pack. We recommend verifying that this rule pack is enabled and reviewing your detections to assess any potential impact to your environment.
Enterprise Plus customers can additionally use the Emerging Threat Center and search for “GLOBAL.26.015” for further details. Enterprise plus customers who have enabled the Threat Hunt Agent in Public Preview can also perform a hunt on GLOBAL.26.015 from the Emerging Threats Center.
Wiz customers can refer to the Wiz Threat Intel Center advisory for PHP2Shell, which includes built-in coverage for agentless and runtime vulnerability detection, exploitation detection via Wiz Defend and Sensor, and automatic response policies, alongside remediation and threat hunting guidance. More information is available here on response steps with Wiz.
Additionally, Mandiant Threat Defense is actively supporting customers by monitoring curated detections in Google Security Operations and hunting for evidence of intrusion activity related to this campaign.
Patching and remediation
The PHP security release has been published. You should update PHP across every server environment, container image, and deployment pipeline. In addition:
As part of Wiz's zero-day response commitment, WizOS PHP images are available at zero billable units for all customers for the next 60 days. WizOS PHP base images, both standard Alpine-hardened and FIPS-compliant builds, are already patched against CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, built from source.
Wiz customers can use the Green Agent to translate the PHP2Shell Threat Intel advisory into resource-tailored remediation guidance, including prescribing the correct PHP patch versions, identifying the right WAF mitigations, recommending opportunities to swap in for hardened WizOS PHP images, and suggesting enabling runtime blocking where there are gaps.
We will continue to monitor the situation closely and provide further updates and guidance as necessary. For the most current information and detailed steps, please refer to the Google Cloud security bulletin.

articles.title: A Multi-granularity Interaction Network for Relational Triple Extraction
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.26952v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Relational triple extraction identifies entity relations from raw sentences without depending on entity type information. The performance of traditional methods is seriously degenerated by ``unseen'' entities, because these methods can't build contextual dependencies relevant ``unseen'' entities. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a multi-granularity interaction network that leverages word-word, entity-relation, and head-tail interactions to capture deep semantic dependencies. By incorporating multiple iterations, the multi-granularity interaction network is effective to refine the representations corresponding to head and tail entities. It enhances the global semantic features associated with relational triples, aiding in the remediation of triples that may have been overlooked or omitted in earlier steps. Strong and consistent performance is achieved by our method on two rearranged datasets, with a significant improvement in identifying relational triples, including those involving ``unseen'' named entities. For example, our model improves F1-score by 3.1%/20.5% over previous approaches on the NYT-R/WebNLG-R datasets in the Unseen metric. Code: https://github.com/xiaocen-luo/Interaction-Network.

articles.title: Multimodal Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition with Bidirectional Audio--Text Cross-Attention
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.26868v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) are subtle behavioural states that can be expressed through both what a person says and how it is spoken. This paper presents an audio--text framework for video-level A/H recognition. Full-video transcripts and speech waveforms are encoded using pre-trained multilingual BERT and wav2vec~2.0, respectively, and projected into a shared representation space. Two stacked bidirectional cross-attention blocks allow linguistic tokens to attend to acoustic frames and acoustic frames to attend to linguistic context without requiring explicit temporal alignment. The resulting sequences are aggregated through masked mean pooling and combined using concatenation, element-wise products, and absolute differences for binary classification. We evaluate the model on the subject-independent split of the Behavioural Ambivalence/Hesitancy (BAH) dataset. The proposed system achieves 72.19\% accuracy, 75.00\% precision, 81.13\% recall, 77.95\% A/H F1-score, and 70.16\% Macro-F1 on the test set. These results demonstrate the potential of jointly modelling linguistic and acoustic information for automatic A/H recognition.code at:https://github.com/DorriG/ECCV.

articles.title: LAMB: Latent Multi-Hypothesis Beliefs for Long-Horizon Large Language Agents
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.26955v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Long-horizon language agents require compact memories that retain interaction evidence while preserving competing hypotheses about unobserved states. Although effective, many belief-state methods encode memory in discrete natural language, where repeated compression can omit evidence or prematurely discard plausible alternatives. We introduce LAMB, a recurrent framework for latent multi-hypothesis beliefs. A Common--Delta factorization combines a shared Common state for interaction evidence with weighted Delta components for competing hypotheses. Relative evidence from action-outcome predictions guides recurrent hypothesis updates without generating textual memory. A context-conditioned readout exposes hypotheses separately to the policy through a fixed-token belief prefix in the default configuration. The belief modules and policy are jointly trained using action imitation and auxiliary state, outcome, and observation-discrimination objectives. Across ALFWorld, BabyAI, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, LAMB matches or outperforms PABU, improving ALFWorld SR@30 and ScienceWorld success by 6.0 and 22.0 percentage points, respectively, and Crafter achievement progress by 26.37 points. On ALFWorld, it also reduces the redundant-action rate by 17.70 percentage points. These results support latent multi-hypothesis beliefs as compact memory for effective long-horizon decision making

articles.title: 李泽湘系团队做了款贴在手机背后的墨水屏Agent，获祥峰、五源、源码等投资｜硬氪首发
articles.text:
作者｜黄楠
编辑｜袁斯来
硬氪获悉，「Flowtica AI」日前已完成新一轮数千万元融资，投资方为祥峰资本、源码资本、五源资本、清水湾基金。山与资本担任独家财务顾问。
过去两年，AI硬件赛道经历了一轮密集的产品迭代。录音卡、翻译耳机、AI眼镜等，几乎每一个能够被大模型增强的物理形态，都有团队在尝试。
而一个尴尬的事实是：AI的能力边界在快速扩张，但普通用户调动它的效率并没有同步提升。用户依然需要主动打开App、输入指令、复制粘贴结果。AI在云端飞速进化，但落到真实工作流里，仍然隔着一段很长的操作路径。
Codex+ChatGPT Work周活跃用户增长曲线（图源/Open AI公开数据整理）
Flowtica最早切入的，正是这段路径里最具体的一环——快速录音。2025年，Flowtica发布了首款AI录音笔产品Scribe，海外众筹超百万元，于2026年初完成发货并常态化销售。
官方数据显示，自Scribe发货以来，有42%的硬件激活用户转化为Flowtica的订阅付费用户。这款产品验证了一件事：用户愿意为会话信息的捕获与整理付费，尤其当AI不止能完成转写，还可以进一步输出结构化纪要、拆解可执行待办。
Flowtica首款产品，AI录音笔Scribe（图源/企业）
但Scribe也让团队看到了一个上限，“录音结束，产品的任务就到此为止——这是市场上绝大多数同类产品的终点。但我们发现，对用户来说，记录只是整个工作流程的开端。”Rian告诉硬氪。
一条会议录音变成了一份纪要，而接下来的待办拆解、日程同步、跟进邮件的草拟等繁复动作，用户仍然需要手动完成。
“模型能力越变越强，但用户与之交互的方式还停留在上一个时代。”在Rian看来，AI硬件的机会，不在于把一堆新功能封装进硬件外壳，而是能主动出现在用户的工作流里。“用户需要的不是一个需要反复唤醒的工具，而是一个能够记录、梳理，并推动事项落地的AI。”
这正是Flowtica团队捕捉到的市场空白：让AI从需要被反复交代的工具，变成能够稳稳地接住用户需求的智能助手。
Verso产品图（图源/企业）
Flowtica创始人Rian毕业于香港科技大学，师从李泽湘教授，拥有计算机视觉与3D方向学术背景。他拥有十余年的硬件创业经历，曾从主导全球首款智能手机手持云台Vimble的研发与量产、农业AI分拣机器人，团队在机器视觉与边缘AI领域积累了完整的工程方法论。
2024年，随着大模型能力开始向终端设备外溢，Rian判断，AI硬件将迎来一轮结构性机会，他成立Flowtica，尝试通过硬件载体实现AI应用深度落地，做下一代AI原生个人硬件与Agent系统。团队带着Scribe积累的供应链能力和对用户场景的理解，开始定义第二款硬件产品Verso。
Verso是一款厚度6.5mm、仅重78g的磁吸式墨水屏Agent硬件。其正面搭载一块常显电子墨水屏，机身配备独立实体交互按键与Type-C充电接口，内置4麦克风阵列与骨传导传感器。
Verso重量参数（图源/企业）
过去十年，消费电子行业默认了一个方向：功能越多、屏幕越炫、参数越强，产品就越有竞争力。但这套逻辑在AI硬件上并不成立。用户面对一块功能密集的屏幕，注意力被不断切割；每一次解锁手机查看通知��都可能陷入分心的信息海洋。
Flowtica 团队在定义产品之初，并没有将追求极致轻薄作为首要目标，而是基于用户真实使用体验权衡取舍。比如多保留0.5mm的机身厚度，换取通用Type‑C接口与额外20小时续航。这类选择在参数表上貌似不讨巧，却直接决定用户长期使用的舒适度。
同样的思路也延伸到了产品功能层面。市面上已经不缺能处理会议的AI工具，录音、转写、摘要，这些能力正在变成标配。但团队认为，真正缺位的不是“如何让会议更智能”，而是如何服务那些会议密度极高的人，帮用户管理注意力和精力，而不是往其信息流中塞更多无效内容。
Verso被设计为一块“主动降噪”的副屏，常显墨水屏让用户“一眼即得”，无需点亮手机，就能掌握当下的日程、核心待办与AI提炼的关键信息。
“我们不是在做一块更吸睛的屏幕，我们是在做一块更安静的屏幕。这种交互方式可以更好地保护用户专注力，让其保持在心流状态中。”Rian告诉硬氪，“AI硬件的价值不在于让用户做更多事，而在于帮用户少做无关的事。”
为了适应高频、碎片化场景，Verso也在ID设计上做了一次反常规的取舍。产品结构采用非对称屏幕布局与侧边实体按键。当用户在通话时，即使单手握住手机的同时，食指也能自然地落在侧边台阶处的录音键，盲操录音。当正面转过来开始阅读时，拇指也能舒适地落在“Ask AI”键上，随时提问与记录。
Verso按键设计（图源/企业）
但硬件只是入口。Flowtica Verso更精准的定位，是一个以硬件为载体的个人上下文操作系统（Personal Context OS），围绕Memory、Attention、Workflow Closure三个层面构建完整闭环。
Memory层解决的是“记住什么”。云端共享大脑把会议、日程、待办、邮件、文档串成一条连续的个人长期记忆，而非停留在一次性转写。信息不再随会议结束而散落，而是沉淀为可随时调取、可跨场景复用的上下文资产。
Attention层解决的是“不被打断”。常显墨水屏、磁吸形态与实体盲操的组合，本质是一套注意力降噪系统——用户无需解锁手机、无需跳入信息流，只需一瞥或一按，就能拿到当下最需要的信息，让注意力保持在心流里，而不是被通知切碎。
Workflow层解决的是“事情真正做完”。从会前Brief、会中标记，到会后Action Items与跟进草稿，系统把“记录”推进到“执行”，形成工作流的完整闭环。会议结束不是终点，而是下一步行动的起点。
三层叠加，Verso才真正成为“Agent硬件”，它不只是拾音与转写的工具，而是一个拥有个人上下文感知能力、可主动执行闭环任务的随身Agent实体入口。
而不同硬件形态，解决的是现实世界里不一样的信息捕获场景，其背后是基于Flowtica自主研发的Cloud-First云端大脑。
Flowtica选择把笔、屏和多端软件放进同一套协同框架里，在工作流上实现多端打通，短期看，既构成了“一脑多终端”的办公产品矩阵；长期看，则是在争夺用户办公信息的入口，进而统一沉淀成可复用的个人资产。
Flowtica产品矩阵（图源/企业）
Rian告诉硬氪，“录音转写、摘要生成这些能力，正在变成基础设施。单点功能的竞争会迅速同质化，真正拉开差距的，在于谁能把分散的信息串成一条连续的线，并且让这条线随着使用时间的增加越来越有价值。”
这句话背后，是Flowtica对产品边界的重新划定。单款硬件只能覆盖工作流中的一个片段，而公司目标远不局限于做出一款好用的录音设备，而是搭建一套覆盖“记录—整理—执行”全链路的办公生态。
Rian进一步指出了一个被行业普遍忽视的体验摩擦，“当下AI能力本身已经不再稀缺，工具看似在提效，但用户每次打开一个AI工具，都要告诉它你是谁、你在做什么、你关心什么。行业不缺智能能力，缺的是上下文的连续性。我们做硬件，就是想让AI能更直达地进入用户的上下文，不需要反复解释。从Scribe录音笔到Verso卡片，再到Apple Watch和Mac，我们在构建的是一个多端生态——在任何场景下，都有一个离你最近的入口，让AI无缝地接住你的上下文。”
据Flowtica透露，Verso自9月在德国IFA正式宣发后，反响热烈，本周已开启定金预收，首批量产产品将于12月正式出货，核心用户瞄准在企业管理者、高强度知识工作者，以及有专注需求（如ADHD）的人群。
以下为硬氪与Flowtica创始人Rian的访谈节选（略经编辑）：
硬���：语音交互已经成为AI硬件的标配，为什么Flowtica还要在硬件上保留一块墨水屏？视觉在这个产品形态里解决了什么问题？
Rian： 语音是最高效的输入方式，但它不是高效的输出方式。
我们在产品定义阶段做过一个很具体的推演，如果Agent用语音给你回一段50字的内容，可能需要30秒才能听完。同样一段信息呈现在屏幕上，你扫一眼就完成了。语音的线性特征决定了它无法被快速浏览、无法被跳读、无法被结构化呈现。用户需要的是“知道什么重要”，而不是“听完所有内容”。
所以我们的判断是，语音负责输入和指令，视觉负责呈现和决策。Agent给出会议纪要、待办拆解、日程准备时，最适合的载体不是语音播报，而是一块能快速扫读的屏幕。
选择墨水屏而不是常规彩色屏，同样基于这个逻辑。手机屏幕的信息过载本身就是问题的一部分——用户每解锁一次手机，就可能被通知、消息、社交应用带离当前任务。墨水屏常显、低刷新、不打扰，它的设计目标不是吸引注意力，而是减少注意力消耗。用户瞥一眼就能掌握日程和关键待办，不需要进入手机的信息流。
这背后是一个更底层的产品判断：Agent硬件的价值不是替代手机，而是在手机之外提供一个更低干扰、更高直达性的信息入口。语音解决“随手记录和下达指令”，视觉解决“快速理解和做出判断”，两者缺一不可。只做录音和语音交互，产品就退化成录音卡；加上视觉和主动呈现，它才具备Agent硬件应有的交互完整性。
硬氪：很多创业公司担心自身产品能力会随着大模型发展逐渐被吃掉。你们怎么判断哪些能力是可持续的，哪些只是过渡性的？
Rian： 我们内部有一个判断标准，如果一项能力的价值随模型变强而缩小，它就不适合作为长期壁垒。
过去很多创业公司做的是“补模型短板”的生意，比如上下文不够长就做压缩，输出不够结构化就做后处理接口，不会调用工具就做一层编排中间件。这些能力在特定阶段有价值，但本质是在填补模型能力与用户需求之间的临时断层。模型每升级一次，断层就收窄一次。
我认为可持续的能力有两类。第一类是与场景深度绑定的用户数据资产。模型是通用的，用户是个性化的。同一个会议，不同的人关注重点不同、表达习惯不同、决策链路不同。这些差异不会因为模型变强而消失，反而需要更强的模型才能被充分理解。我们的Memory系统记录的不只是会议内容，还有行为模式、关注偏好和任务推进习惯。模型越强，这些数据的价值越大。
第二类是产品层的交互定义与场景编排。模型提供通用能力，但“在什么时机、以什么方式介入用户的工作流”是产品层的问题。同样一个会议结束，Agent该主动弹出待办拆解，还是等用户开口问？这些判断不取决于模型能力，而取决于对用户场景的理解。
此外，合规与数据基础设施也是容易被低估的壁垒。我们从去年开始，就在推进各项数据合规，这类能力不是模型能解决的，需要时间、流程和持续投入，一旦建立就是长期的信任壁垒。
所以我们不做“补模型短板”的中间层，而是做“放大模型能力”的场景层。前者的价值随模型增强而衰减，后者的价值随模型增强而增长。

articles.title: Cross-Lingual Reusability of LLM Pipelines: Financial Extraction, Multilingual Reasoning, and Semantic Screening
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27043v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Financial institutions increasingly deploy large language models (LLMs) in multilingual markets, raising a practical question: can pipelines developed and validated in English be reused across languages, or must they be rebuilt per locale? We test cross-lingual reusability along three dimensions--accuracy, reasoning-effort transfer, and behavioural stability--through three complementary tasks. Task 1 (cheque extraction) and Task 2 (Mintaka QA with pinned evidence across nine languages and nine model-effort configurations) test whether accuracy and effort settings transfer; Task 3 (FinanceBench pilot, 50 items over SEC 10-K filings in four languages) validates whether these patterns generalise to financial content. Accuracy reusability is broadly confirmed: Gemini 3.5 Flash achieves 95.2-97.6% extraction accuracy across prompt languages, and FinanceBench per-language means span 5.8pp (77.1-82.9%), though the language-difficulty ranking reverses between domains (Hindi is worst on Mintaka, best on FinanceBench at 82.9%). Effort reusability is domain-dependent: higher reasoning effort yields marginal gains on general-knowledge QA but up to 8pp on financial content, and effort configurations that help in English help proportionally in other languages. Behavioural reusability holds: citation-set overlap with English averages 77-79% Jaccard, with no single language consistently worse. Together, these results support qualified reuse of English-built pipelines, but per-domain, per-language validation remains necessary--neither semantic similarity nor self-reported confidence reliably predicts cross-lingual accuracy.

articles.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
articles.text:
Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion. Whether they actually work as antivenom remains an open question.

articles.title: iPhone Duo首发体验：大量App还没适配 打开全是大黑边
articles.text:
快科技10月21日消息，影视飓风实测了iPhone Duo的日常使用体验，发现很多APP还没有进行适配。
第三方热门App的适配水平参差不齐，影视飓风给他们分成三类。第一类是凑合优化，能铺满大屏，但经常出现黑边，界面偶尔重叠，勉强能用。
第二类完全没有优化，打开之后会出现大面积黑边，部分拍摄软件连陀螺仪都会错乱，画面方向完全颠倒，根本没法正常使用。
微信
而第三类优化到位的App体验会好很多，包括爱奇艺、飞书等等，横竖切换画面很顺畅。B站已经支持4：3视频播放，观感更好。
爱奇艺
部分软件支持单应用双窗口，两个网页可以并排打开，还能直接拖拽图片跨窗口传输。AI交互体验比直板手机更顺手，拖拽就能把图片和文档转移到别的窗口。
首发入手的用户，很长一段时间里都会碰到适配问题，不过苹果已经给开发者定下期限，明年4月所有App必须完成适配。
另外要注意的是，iPhone Duo并不能安装iPad版本软件。
其他体验方面，这款手机合上机身之后，宽度比普通iPhone高出一大截。手大的人单手操作没问题，手小的同事拿着就很勉强。
机身纵向屏幕更短，显示文字会少一整段，很多页面必须调出侧边栏才能正常浏览。

articles.title: Sharp Degree Bounds for Putinar Certificates in Terms of the Positivity Margin via Analytic Sums of Squares
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.26976v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We establish sharp degree bounds for Putinar sum-of-squares (SOS) certificates in terms of the positivity margin $\delta$. For any fixed Archimedean quadratic module with prescribed generators and any fixed bound on the degree of the objective, we prove a uniform certificate-degree upper bound of $O(\delta^{-1/2}\log^2(2/\delta))$ for normalized polynomial objectives. We show that this bound is sharp by constructing a matching lower-bound example in three variables, thereby establishing that the dependence on $\delta$ is optimal. These matching bounds also yield sharp worst-case convergence rates for the Lasserre hierarchy.

articles.title: Interspecies communication
articles.text:
Humans are far from the only species with a gift for gab, and our furry, feathered, and finned friends could have a lot to tell us. Decoding how animals communicate with one another could offer a window into the inner lives of other species and help humans realize that “animals are sentient creatures who think, who have hopes and dreams of their own,” says Con Slobodchikoff, the founder of Zoolingua, a company working on dog-to-human speech.
The sticking points
Teasing all this out is complex. To decipher howls, squeaks, and clicks, researchers must match the creatures making sounds with what’s happening around them. Prairie dogs, for example, utter a different series of yips when a coyote approaches than when a hawk is nearby. It’s painstaking work, especially for difficult-to-­observe species, like deep-diving whales or subterranean mole rats.
There are other hurdles. Many animals communicate not just through sound but through visual cues, touch, pheromones, or a combination of signals, some of which might be difficult for us to perceive. And without a multispecies Rosetta stone, it’s hard to know if translations are accurate.
The progress
Over the past 50 years, a growing arsenal of devices has made it easier to observe the sophisticated ways animals communicate. Hydrophones at the bottom of the ocean can capture humpback whale song, and tiny wearable “biologgers” can record a bat’s every squeak.
In the last decade, advances in AI have leveled up our ability to make sense of it all. The technology can detect different calls, distinguish which sounds belong to which animal, and spot patterns. Researchers at the Earth Species Project (ESP), a nonprofit founded in 2018 to decode animal communication, recently used machine learning to detect vocalizations of carrion crows and determine which bird made which call.
They suspect that more advanced AI could translate critters’ chatter. Large language models like Claude and ChatGPT excel at finding relationships between words, explains Sara Keen, one of ESP’s behavioral ecologists. ESP hopes its own NatureLM—trained on human speech, music, and animal sounds—will be able to interpret the vocalizations of a variety of species.
That promise, however, is still theoretical. Yossi Yovel, a neuroecologist at Tel Aviv University, worries that these models will put too much emphasis on acoustic similarities and make mistakes—like lumping together similar sounds that have different meanings.
As for a two-way convo? It’s not clear when—or whether—that will happen. Still, “a lot of animals have an evolutionary structure that is similar enough that we should be able to understand what they’re saying,” Slobodchikoff says.
Progress meter ………… 4
Researchers have amassed heaps of data on animal communication, but they’re still trying to figure out how to decipher it all.

articles.text:

articles.title: DStill: Trajectory Consistency Distillation for Accelerated One-Step Drafting in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27379v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using a curriculum that gradually transitions from partial to fully masked inputs, we successfully transfer the multi-step refinement capabilities into one step. Across reasoning, math, code benchmarks on three model families DStill improves acceptance length by up to 28% and speedup by up to 25% over one-step DFlash, achieving up to 6.45x speedup over auto-regressive decoding.

articles.title: 从安防到工业，海康威视底气从何而来
articles.text:
2026年中国国际工业博览会的工业自动化展区，海康威视的展台被人群围了好几层。一百多款场景数字化产品铺开在眼前，从亚微米级精度的半导体封装3D AXI检测设备，到能在3200℃极限高温下看清工业现场的高清可视高温计，从为皮带托辊“悬丝诊脉”的听诊光纤，到给筒仓做三维建模的扫描成像雷达。有人感叹，“海康真的不止于安防了”，也有人在这片“含AI量十足”的展台前停下来，试图想明白一个问题：这家以安防立身的公司，凭什么能在工业领域扎下这么深的根？要回答这个问题，不妨把视线从展台移开，看看工业制造现场正在发生的变化。
01
场景数字化，工业升级的必答题
过去二十多年，互联网数字化深刻重塑了消费、社交、金融、娱乐等行业。人和活动信息的线上化，催生了全球市值最高的科技公司，也改变了几乎每一个人的日常生活。但这波浪潮有一个边界，它完成的是人与活动信息的数字化，物理世界本身，那些庞大的工厂、运转的产线、高温的炉膛、绵延数公里的皮带，它们的数字化进程远未完成。当前，AI大模型与多维感知技术正加速成熟，物理世界物联网数据的数字化正在释放巨大的产业空间。据赛迪顾问数据，2025年中国工业互联网市场规模达到12587.8亿元，同比增长12.6%，预计到2028年将达16753.5亿元，工业互联网将进一步向智能化、数据驱动和系统级协同方向演进。这是一条厚雪长坡的赛道。政策层面的信号同样明确。“十五五”规划纲要提出“实施新技术新产品新场景大规模应用示范行动，加大场景培育和开放力度”，2026年《政府工作报告》进一步提出“打造智能经济新形态”，强调深化拓展“人工智能+”。场景的价值正在于此，它把技术创新从实验室搬到真实的场景中，成为新技术新产品的“试验场”，架起研发与市场的桥梁，加速科技创新成果向现实生产力转化。中国工业从“全”到“强”的升级，恰恰需要这种场景思维。中国拥有41个工业大类、207个中类、666个小类，是全球唯一拥有联合国产业分类中全部工业门类的国家。这种“全、多、大”的特征，意味着工业场景的碎片化程度远超想象。一套通用方案包打天下的时代已经过去，技术必须在真实场景中试炼，在具体问题中生效。这正是海康威视讲“场景数字化”的底层逻辑。场景是落脚点，数字化是路径。行业内不少厂商单独讲“场景”或单独讲“数字化”，但将二者结合形成统一产业认知的并不多见。海康威视之所以能明确提出这一概念，是因为它同时具备几个条件：从可见光起步拓展到红外、X光、毫米波、声波等多维感知技术体系，能够深入物理世界帮助用户采集各类数据；海康观澜大模型实现了多模态大模型与行业知识的深度融合，能在具体场景中读懂数据、解决问题；更重要的是技术延伸逻辑，海康威视几乎所有工业技术都能在安防领域找到成熟的技术前身。安防要“看清异常”，工业要“感知数据”；安防要“智能预警”，工业要“预测性维护”，二者都需要感知与智能的结合。
02
感知与AI的「飞轮效应」
理解场景数字化的重要性之后，下一个问题是：海康威视凭什么能做好这件事？答案藏在它多年积累的感知与AI能力之中。首先在于感知技术的全面性。工业场景的碎片化，意味着单一感知手段往往难以适配复杂工况。正如人类不能只靠眼睛认识世界，工业领域的信息获取也需要“眼耳鼻舌身”的协同。海康威视已构建起覆盖可见光、红外、X光、毫米波、融合光谱、声波等多领域的物联感知技术体系。公司在售硬件产品型号超过3万个，软件产品100多款，能够满足各行各业不同场景的差异化需求。这种多维感知能力的价值，在芯片质量检测场景中就得到了体现。针对芯片检测这一典型复杂场景，海康构建了从宏观到微观、从内部到表面、从量测到物质分析的完整产品体系：高精度半导体封装3D AXI检测设备拥有亚微米级透视检测能力，可精准识别内部金线、焊点、贯穿型缺陷等芯片深层缺陷；超声显微镜可识别微米级缺陷，对平面层裂痕检测灵敏度极高；超景深3D数码显微镜能清晰捕捉芯片表面划痕、溢胶等微观缺陷；质谱与色谱设备可精准检测芯片焊盘表面是否残留光刻胶、助焊剂等有机污染物……感知之外，AI大模型赋予了海康威视解决“老大难”问题的能力。传统工业检测方案面临的核心困境在于：每个场景都需要单独采集数据、标注训练、调试部署，周期长达数周、成本高昂，且产品一换型就要推倒重来。海康观澜大模型的小样本学习与强泛化能力，则大幅降低了这一门槛。以海康睿影的X-ray工业检测大模型为例，过去一个检测对象，需要数千至上万张标注图片，如今仅需几十张样本即可完成模型训练部署。某些特殊场景下，凭借无监督的大模型技术，仅需3至5张样本即可快速上线，极大提升了迭代效率。大模型基于海量多行业数据完成预训练，掌握缺陷通用本质特征，能分清“真缺陷”和“长得像缺陷的正常形态”，判定边界更清晰、识别逻辑更贴合工业实景，有效降低误报、提升整体检测准确率。同样，在超声检测领域，海康威视自主研发了知识增强信号重建网络和超声大模型，通过自适应噪声分离、先验知识嵌入、自监督预训练加少样本迁移、自动定量分析等方法，让AI像资深老师傅一样精准读懂波形与信号。在新能源汽车零部件检测场景中，单工件检测效率提升60%以上，缺陷识别准确率不低于99.5%。这种“感知+AI”能力的叠加，形成了海康威视在工业领域的一种独特定位：既能用多维感知手段“看得见”工业场景中各类要素，又能用AI大模型“看得懂”数据背后的含义。物联感知、AI这两大核心技术，就像一对“飞轮”，相互驱动。物联感知技术的发展，将物理世界数字化，可为AI能力的飞跃提供场景支撑；AI能力的发展，又能不断提升物联感知设备的性能，并催生出大量工业级应用。
03
场景中的答卷
能力是否有效，最终要到场景中检验。在质量检测领域，折叠屏手机铰链检测是海康睿影攻下的一个标志性场景。2022年底，折叠屏铰链仍属于新兴工艺，产品结构精密复杂、缺陷特征细微、成像干扰极强，生产过程衍生十余类疑难缺陷，靠人眼及传统光学检测设备无法有效识别。海康睿影与客户组建专项攻坚团队，基于X射线大模型智能检测系统，实现对裂纹、气孔、异物等各类缺陷的稳定检出，精度最小可达0.05mm。通过X光AI全检，不良率下降1个数量级，大幅提升产品良率。该方案率先落地头部标杆客户后，迅速向全手机行业扩展。在生产运营领域，产线行为SOP检测方案已经跑出规模化复制的节奏。柔性制造趋势下，同一条产线快速切换品类、按需排产，不同产品、工位、物料的作业标准差异大，如何保证产品质量成为难题。海康威视打造的SOP行为检测系统方案，自带开箱即用的常见产线算法，面对新工件、新场景仅需1至8张图片即可适配，实现分钟级部署。在海康威视重庆、桐庐、武汉生产基地的600余个核心工位上线后，单位工位相较原人工方式提效最高达80%。理想汽车供应链体系中的继峰座椅通过SOP行为检测系统，座椅C型钉漏打率大幅下降至最低0.01%，并将方案复用到上下游供应商团队。动力系统供应商联合动力覆盖了100%关键作业工序，从定子装配到端子压接，AI全程巡检，实时校验操作规范。目前，海康威视SOP方案已在全国累计落地数百个项目，覆盖汽车零部件、3C电子、半导体、食品包装等多行业。在设备监测领域，海康威视在业内首创的定位型听诊光纤提供了一个“深水区”解决方案。工业皮带在国内约有三十万条，一些长皮带造价达上亿元。传统巡检依赖人眼和人耳，环境恶劣、噪声大、粉尘重，长皮带长达数公里，巡检耗时困难。海康威视创新性地将光纤传感探头安装在皮带传输机上，通过采集托辊声音结合AI算法精准定位故障。这项技术获得了2025全国创新方法大赛唯一金奖，已在南京钢铁、华新水泥、华东材料等多家企业落地应用。在机器人与雷达领域，海康威视的市场验证数据同样扎实。2025年海康机器人全年营收64.52亿元，截至目前，海康机器人视觉产品累计出货超1000万台，移动机器人下线突破20万台，国内市场每两台工业相机、每三台移动机器人中，就有一台来自海康机器人，累计服务客户超2万家。海康工业雷达从车载领域的技术积累延伸而来，构建了从一维单点测距的物位计，到二维截面成像雷达，再到三维扫描成像雷达和四维避障雷达的完整产品体系。在陕西商洛发电，激光扫描成像雷达短短3分钟就能完成一次全方位盘库，准确率达到97%以上，盘煤效率较以往提升几十倍。值得一提的是，海康威视自身也是这些技术最直接的试验场。海康威视智能工厂硬件产品型号达3万余种，日均处理订单1.4万个，每个订单平均仅约30台，定配置比例高达70%。面对这种“多品种、小批量、大规模定制”的生产特点，海康威视将自研的物联感知、AI大模型等技术深度融入制造全流程，超过1500台移动机器人协同作业，智能摄像机全自动化无人生产线较传统线体效率提升243%。2025年，海康威视智能制造工厂入选全国首批领航级智能工厂培育名单。
04
结语
上一波互联网数字化浪潮，完成了人和活动信息的线上化，释放了巨大的产业红利。而物理世界的数字化，正在开启一个同样广阔的产业空间。工厂里的每一台设备、每一条产线、每一道工序，都蕴含着等待被感知、被理解、被优化的需求。海康威视要做的事情，就是架起物理世界与数字世界之间的那座桥梁。用覆盖可见光、红外、X光、毫米波、声波等多维度的感知能力，将物理世界的信息转化为可分析的数字信号；用海康观澜大模型读懂这些信号背后的含义，辅助决策、指导执行，让工业制造真正实现从“看见”到“看懂”的跃迁。工业的数字化、智能化升级，始于每一个真实场景。从展台上的一百余款产品，到产线上的一个个工位，再到千行百业的一个个细分应用场景，海康威视的场景数字化实践正在回答一个根本性的命题：
当技术走出实验室，走进工业现场，走进每一个具体的生产环节，它创造的价值才真正落地生根。而这，正是物理世界数字化浪潮中最坚实的底座。
（雷峰网）（雷峰网）

articles.title: 双11首日：天猫稳居品牌成交主阵地，124个品牌成交破亿
articles.text:
10月20日晚8点，天猫双11正式开卖，数亿消费者涌入淘宝。在平台消费券带动下，消费需求集中释放，全球品牌迎来成交爆发。
开卖后，“分钟级”爆发接连上演。珀莱雅蕴白水乳套装1秒售罄，1分钟后FILA成交破1亿。开卖1小时，鲜朗售出80万袋猫粮，丝塔芙大白罐售出14万件，亚朵深睡枕售出3.4万单，好欢螺螺狮粉售出3.3万单，旺家福鸡脚筋售出1.7万单。
数据显示，天猫稳居双11品牌成交主阵地。开卖4小时，124个品牌成交额破亿，27681个品牌成交额超去年全天，淘宝直播破亿直播间增至14个。
各行业头部品牌持续突破成交上限。在iPhone新品带动下，苹果品牌成交额同比增长400%。优衣库24分钟破亿。adidas开卖1小时成交超2亿。珀莱雅和卡诗开卖4小时双位数增长。源氏木语开卖1小时成交同比增长96.5%。Nintendo任天堂成交同比增长94.7%。
新品牌涌现行业黑马，开卖即跑出高增速。美妆品牌Fan Beauty Diary开卖1小时破亿、同比翻倍。鞋履品牌PANE增长超100%。鲜朗成为宠物行业第1个首小时破亿品牌。个护品牌Off&Relax 4小时成交首次破亿。食品品牌太阳谷4小时成交超去年全周期。首次参与双11的进口品牌数超1300家，covernat、bioisland等16个新品牌迅速破百万。
新品成为重要增长点。102个新品成交突破千万，1113个新品成交突破百万。苹果天猫官旗iPhone配件首次可使用消费券，40W型号充电头成交破千万。lululemon新款CrossChill运动夹克上市即热卖，单品成交破千万。
新品类赛道涌现。228个新品类赛道同比增长超50%，117个新品类赛道同比增长超100%。其中，AIPC电脑品类首小时增长超300%，首登双11的Token品类，环比上月成交增长450%。
双11国补拉动效应显著。国补覆盖的3C数码品类同比增长超4倍，手机品类增长超9倍，电视、智能家居等均两位数增长，充分展现了政策红利与平台大促叠加下，居民消费提质升级的强劲动能。
服务打开品牌增长新空间。双11天猫首次大规模落地“送装拆旧一次搞定”服务，激活换新活力，变形家具成交增长55%，轻定制家具增长49%，100吋大屏电视增长30%。双11越来越快，阿里健康大药房第一单药品12分钟送货上门。
美妆爆款单品创纪录。除了珀莱雅之外，修丽可、SK-II、赫莲娜等高端奢美品牌成交额均同比双位数增长。修丽可Age面霜成为第一个在天猫双11开售日破3亿的美妆单品。珀莱雅红宝石面霜成分升级，开卖4小时销售超45万件。
服饰爆发加速度，设计驱动新增长。双11首小时，每过3.5分钟即诞生一个百万新品牌，平均1.1分钟涌现一个千万品牌。波司登、维密、百丽、山下有松等品牌纷纷破亿。箱包百万级爆品80%由国内设计师品牌贡献，裘真突破150%高增长。
运动户外头部品牌稳健领跑，专业功能性品牌爆发增长。FILA、adidas、lululemon开卖后成交快速破亿；Salomon、Helly Hansen、Wilson、Mammut、vuori、maia active、佑美等细分赛道品牌均取得高双位数增长，Mammut首小时超去年全天，Helly Hansen4小时同比增长超70%。
今年天猫双11吸引100万全球品牌、7200万款商品参与，基础优惠力度低至7.2折，为历年来力度最大，让消费者享受到实实在在的价格优惠。

articles.title: MMedAgent-Plus: Scaling Multimodal Medical Agents across Modalities, Tasks and Workflows
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27233v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Medical workflows often require multiple interdependent analyses, but existing specialist and generalist AI models are not designed to coordinate them. We introduce MMedAgent-Plus, a multimodal medical tool-use agent that combines a vision-language planner with 18 leading specialist models spanning 12 tasks and 8 modalities. Through a unified tool interface, the planner selects specialists, executes them in sequence, and synthesizes responses grounded in their outputs. The planner is instruction-tuned on 208,928 samples from 32 public medical benchmarks, covering single- and multi-tool interactions across single and multiple rounds. We separately evaluate tool orchestration, response synthesis, and end-to-end execution on held-out samples. MMedAgent-Plus achieves tool-call accuracies of 91.0%, 98.1%, and 80.7% in single-tool multi-round, multi-tool multi-round, and multi-tool single-round settings, respectively. Given correct tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus achieves scores of 14.4-14.8 out of 15 for faithfulness, completeness, and conciseness across 600 evaluation samples. In end-to-end execution without pre-supplied tool outputs, MMedAgent-Plus correctly invokes the required specialist in 90.6% of 350 evaluation cases spanning seven tasks. Its final-answer accuracy reaches 0.98, matching the dedicated leading specialist and exceeding the strongest baseline (0.28).

articles.title: 我用 iPhone Duo 刷小红书、淘宝、飞书，发现作用不只是装「阔」
articles.text:
头图图片来源：极客公园
我在 iPhone Duo 上，把淘宝、高德、小红书、腾讯视频、飞书、WPS、XMind，还有篮球游戏 NBA 巅峰对决，这 8 个为它做过适配的 App 挨个用了一遍。淘宝从首页到客服消息，整条购物链路都动过；高德把路线和地图拆成了左右两半；小红书的笔记，变成了左边看图、右边看正文和评论。
这台手机的国行首批预订已经售罄。据环球时报 10 月 17 日的报道，苹果官网显示的预计交付时间，排到了明年二月，等货的这几个月，其实大家最关心答案的问题只有一个：除了更「阔」，它和我们用了这么多年的直板 iPhone，体验到底有什么不一样。
对 iPhone 来讲答案是，合上的时候，它最像一台普通 iPhone，区别只是程序坞、状态栏和灵动岛挪到了屏幕侧边，竖着排。真正的不同发生在另外两种状态里：完全展开，App 会把一屏分成左右两栏；半折立在桌上，上半屏用来看，下半屏用来操作。
内屏分成两栏
淘宝是这次改得最全的一个。直板 iPhone 上看一件商品，是先看头图，再往下滑看标题和详情。Duo 展开后，主图在左，标题、价格和详情在右，边看图边看描述。合着的时候也改了，详情页的头图比例调过，一屏能同时看到两张图和标题、价格。
首页和搜索结果可以双指捏合，在两列到四列之间调，想看大图就放大，想一屏多看几件就缩小。购物车里能看到完整的商品标题和优惠信息。
改得最实用的是消息页。左边是商家列表，右边是聊天窗口。一次要跟好几家店问尺码、问发货，在直板 iPhone 上，每换一家都得退回列表再点进去；在 Duo 上，左边点一下，右边就换了一家。
淘宝还有两个新功能在测，AI 试穿和试妆，目前在灰度阶段，只有测试版入口能用。上传一张自己的半身或全身照，右边挑上衣、裤子、鞋和帽子，淘宝的说法是一件衣服一分钟内出效果；试妆直接用前置摄像头。不过试穿本身跟折叠屏关系不大，大屏给它的是右边那块挑衣服的地方。
淘宝针对横屏场景优化的 AI 试穿效果｜图片来源：极客公园
对日常使用直屏手机习惯的用户来讲，在 iPhone Duo 上平时随手下单，合上用就够了。双十一要比价、要跟几家客服来回问的那几天，才是它最该展开的时候。
在出门这件事上，高德改版之后的优势最为明显。在直板 iPhone 上查一条路线，屏幕上是几条方案排成一列，能比较的只有时间和距离；这条路现在堵不堵、终点附近好不好停车，得点进去，再把地图放大缩小看一遍。
在 Duo 上展开，左边是路线方案和预计用时，右边是整张地图，起点附近的路况、终点的停车场和加油站都在上面。
打车也一样，左边是行程信息，右边一直显示那辆车开到了哪。扫街榜则是左边榜单、右边地图，附近哪家店分高、离自己多远，同时就能看到。
开车导航这次是高德针对 iPhone Duo 体验适配的重点：高德放了一段路测视频，演示的是双视野模式：左半屏是车道级导航，告诉你该走哪条车道、什么时候并线；右半屏是一张往前看三到五公里的地图。高德团队的说法是，开车时在单屏上放大缩小、点全览本身就危险，两种视角同时摆着，就不用再伸手。
双视野导航效果｜图片来源：高德
另一项是分屏：左边开聊天软件，朋友在群里发来餐厅定位，点一下，右边的高德就弹出这家店，直接发起导航。这两项目前都只有视频演示，要等后续版本更新。
高德地图针对 iPhone Duo 开发的功能：将高德地图内的地点快速分享到对话中｜图片来源：极客公园
这里 iPhone Duo 需要回答的问题是，类似横屏设备本来就能分屏，为什么还要专门适配？高德团队的解释是，这牵涉跨 App 传递信息。系统分屏只是让两个 App 同时摆出来，要让聊天里的一个定位直接变成右边的导航，得 App 自己去接。这是直板 iPhone 上从来没有过的一种区别，也是目前做得最少的一种。
上班的场景里，直板 iPhone 一直有三个别扭的地方：表格得拖来拖去才能看全，对比两个版本要在文件之间来回切，打字时键盘挡掉半屏。
WPS 展开后，左边是侧栏、中间是正文，布局几乎就是电脑版，很多表格展开后能一屏看完。
改过的文档和原稿可以并排打开，一起滑动对照，哪里的金额改了，一眼就能看出来。WPS 的智能助理原来是从底部拉出来的抽屉，会挡住正文，现在改成左右分栏，一边看建议一边改。
飞书把看和聊放到了一起。同事发来一段视频，可以分屏，上面看、下面聊，界面还会跟着折叠角度调整；会后用妙记回看，左边是会议视频，右边是文字记录和纪要。
飞书在 iPhone Duo 上的适配效果｜图片来源：极客公园
飞书在 iPhone Duo 外屏的演示效果｜图片来源：极客公园
XMind 让大纲和思维导图并排出现，也能同时打开两个文件，一个当参考，一个接着整理。
XMind 针对 iPhone Duo 优化的显示界面｜图片来源：极客公园
立在桌上的新角度
差别最大的是追剧。直板 iPhone 看剧，要么竖着看小画面，要么横过来全屏，进度条和弹幕输入框都叠在画面上，而且得一直拿在手里。Duo 多了一种姿势：半折，立在桌上。
腾讯视频在这个状态下，把视频集中到上半屏，下半屏是精简过的操作区，拖进度、截图、发弹幕都在下面完成，发弹幕时画面不会被遮住。从合着的状态把它支成一个小帐篷，就能全屏播放。
腾讯视频在 iPhone Duo 内屏/外屏不同摆放方式下的播放效果｜图片来源：极客公园
上周库克来中国时，专程抽时间去了一趟爱奇艺，看的也是类似的交互设计；10 月 14 日，已经卸任 CEO、现任苹果执行董事长的库克到访爱奇艺北京总部，爱奇艺给他演示的就是手机半折，上半屏放片，下半屏调进度、倍速、画质和弹幕。库克随后发文，称赞了这款应用的优化。
小红书的变化在刷内容上。外屏还是熟悉的双列，展开后一屏能看到更多笔记。
小红书将功能菜单移动到了屏幕右侧底部｜图片来源：极客公园
点进一篇，图片在左，正文和评论在右，不用看完图再往下翻评论。看视频笔记时，合上手机，外屏会接着播；微折放在桌上，视频在上，评论在下，互动不挡画面。
小红书横屏显示布局效果｜图片来源：极客公园
对折叠屏适配优化而言，游戏也是同一个思路。NBA 巅峰对决半折时，上面是完整的比赛画面，下面是操作区，球员数据直接显示在操作区里，不用暂停、另开一个页面去查，开发者的形容是像在玩掌机。
NBA 游戏在 iPhone Duo 竖屏下显示效果｜图片来源：极客公园
WPS 则把这种姿势留给了输入：半折时，下半屏是一整块键盘；录音转文字时，上面滚动显示文字，下面是录音状态。
看剧、刷小红书、打游戏这些传统娱乐体验，是 Duo 离直板手机最远的地方。腾讯视频和小红书都说，23 日上架的版本会比这次的体验版更完整。
和直板 iPhone 比，Duo 的区别不在合上的时候，而在三种用法：展开分两栏，半折立在桌上，两个 App 并排。
虽然在 iPhone Duo 的首发时刻，大家先记住的，多半还会是 iPhone Duo 那块能展开的屏幕，这很正常，它一眼就能看见。但相信随着首发的狂热逐渐过去，问题的重点还是会逐渐回归到同样值得说的是另一半：App 开始重新想，这么大一块屏幕该怎么用。
每个 App 交出的答案，都不一样。同样是半折，腾讯视频拿下半屏发弹幕，NBA 巅峰对决拿它看球员数据，WPS 拿它当键盘，XMind 想的是让学生把待办清单立在桌上。苹果在 iOS 27 里，连铰链开合的角度都开放给了开发者，App 能实时读到手机此刻折到了多少度。
目前，这显然还只是应用大厂们在 iPhone Duo 这个平台上给出的第一批答案。等更多 App 想出自己的用法，折叠屏比的就不只是谁的屏幕更大了。

articles.title: WORTH Benchmark: Evidence Discovery under Not-Fully-Cooperative Information -- A Two-Episode Pilot
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27597v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Existing reasoning evaluations typically provide task-relevant information to models as available premises, rarely examining concurrently how models discover evidence autonomously and how information presentation within narratives guides or obscures judgment. This paper proposes the WORTH Benchmark: models read original mystery narratives without clue annotations, autonomously select key clue sentences, identify case participants, and explain their reasoning process. The narrative materials are designed by professional authors such that evidence facilitating reasoning coexists with narrative arrangements that delay the revelation of truth. We report a pilot experiment under full-story conditions across two episodes, conducting a total of 70 formal runs on models, of which 67 runs are content-scorable. Scoring separately records hits on author-designated key clue sentences and participant selections; natural language explanations are used for case diagnosis and are not scored independently. The results show that clue hits and participant judgments are not synchronized; across 37 content-scorable runs in Episode 02, 31 runs simultaneously selected the same set of incorrect participants, while adjacent suspicion-oriented and exoneration-oriented sentences were selected 25 times and 0 times, respectively. These phenomena illustrate the diagnostic value of component-wise analysis and suggest that not-fully-cooperative informational relationships may influence evidence selection and judgment. This study only implements full-story conditions for two episodes, and does not establish stable model rankings or infer general mechanisms on this basis; human player records have not yet been cleaned, and this version does not report human-model comparisons.

articles.text:
智东西
作者 | 程茜

智东西10月21日消息，今日，据五源资本披露，上海个人AI助手创企此间无限（Today AI）已累计完成2亿美元（折合人民币约13.36亿元）融资，IDG资本、腾讯、五源资本、蚂蚁集团、红杉中国、传音控股、同歌创投、上海交大菡源资产参投。
Today AI成立于2026年3月，创始人为前字节飞书产品副总裁、豆包PC端负责人齐俊元。其核心产品个人AI助手Today国内版于9月25日上线，可以主动记录用户的工作、日常事项，如当天的行程安排、工作项目总结、定制学习计划、健康情况等。该产品支持iOS、安卓、Windows、Mac、Linux。
根据官方信息，Today能够在长期交互中持续理解用户，在用户主动提出需求之前，主动提供适配的协助。
▲使用Today自动添加日程安排（图源：Today AI）
目前，Today支持连接企业微信、微信读书、百度网盘、金山文档、腾讯会议等应用，可以记录用户的工作群消息、读书金句、在网盘找文档、实时更新修改记录、提供会议纪要等。
齐俊元是国内知名90后连续创业者，本科毕业于上海交通大学。
他在2011年读大三时，创办了企业协作软件Teambition，并在2013至2014年间带领团队完成Pre-A轮至A轮融资。2016年，Teambition获得腾讯战略投资，并在2019年以约1亿美元被阿里巴巴收购。
收购完成后，齐俊元加入阿里巴巴，担任阿里云盘负责人（P9），主导产品研发并推动其于2021年正式上线。
2023年1月，齐俊元加入字节跳动，担任飞书产品副总裁，并向CEO谢欣汇报。
2024年1月，他转岗至字节Flow团队，负责豆包PC端产品。2025年9月，字节AI条线进行组织调整，人力资源负责人赵祺转岗至Spring产品部门负责豆包产品工作，豆包PC端、移动端以及模型策略相关负责人均改为向赵祺汇报。2025年11月，齐俊元从字节跳动离职。
▲齐俊元（图源：飞书）

结语：个人Agent竞速开启，大厂、创企均已入局

articles.title: 4TB Samsung 990 Pro M.2 SSD falls 27%, hits 20 cents per gigabyte
articles.text:
At one point in time, it was the fastest PCIe Gen 4 drive you could buy. Now, the next generation of PCIe 5.0 drives is available, but the 4TB Samsung 990 Pro still offers extremely fast performance and whopping amounts of capacity in a single-sided M.2 2280 form factor. The main issue at the moment is price. Thanks to the AI boom driving up the prices of memory and storage, SSDs have reached insane highs, so to be able to take advantage of a large 27% discount in these times is nothing to be sniffed at. The 4TB Samsung 990 Pro has fallen from $1,099 to this new price of $799.90, a saving of over $300. This works out as roughly 20 cents per Gigabyte of storage capacity.
● Grab this SSD deal at Amazon
Having reviewed the Samsung 990 Pro 4TB when it was released, we found it to be one of the best 4TB SSDs on the market and among the best SSDs overall. The 990 Pro boasts maximum sequential reads of 7,450 MB/s and sequential writes of 6,900 MB/s, with random reads/writes coming in at 1.6 million and 1.55 million IOPS, respectively, while endurance is rated for 2,400 TBW.
990 Pro 4TB SSD: was $1099.99 now $799.90
The Samsung 990 Pro 4TB is among the fastest Gen 4 SSDs available thanks to read and write speeds of up to 7450/6900 MB/s, almost maxing out the Gen 4 bandwidth. This M.2 NVMe drive comes in the 2280 form factor and holds enough capacity to store a large selection of your favorite games or files.
Random reads/writes come in at 1.6 million and 1.55 million IOPS, respectively, while endurance is rated for a respectable 2,400 TBW.View Deal
Samsung uses 236-layer TLC V-NAND to achieve its 4TB capacity, while also using a single-sided design, making the 990 Pro ideal for use in computers where space is a finite resource. When we tested the Samsung 990 Pro 4TB, we found it scored above the competition on almost every test. On 3DMark's storage test, it had the lowest latency result, a big plus for responsive load times in gaming.
(Image credit: Tom's Hardware)
The Samsung 990 Pro is also excellent at sustaining strong write performance. In our IOMeter sustained sequential write tests, the 4TB 990 Pro was able to maintain a speed of 6.2 GB/s for 75 seconds thanks to its generous 10GB of pSLC cache. Once the data spills over into the TLC, it operates at 1.6 GB/s. The Samsung 990 Pro is also a leader in power efficiency, delivering 421.1 MB/s per watt. That number puts it ahead of all competitors but the Addlink A93 4TB and Lexar NM790 4TB.
(Image credit: Tom's Hardware)
The Samsung 990 Pro is certainly nowhere near the all-time low prices of years gone by, and I'm not sure at the moment when, if at all, we'll ever see those low prices again on storage, certainly not for some considerable time. If you want 4TB of storage now, then the Samsung 990 Pro is a formidable choice; just try to grab it when there's as much of a discount as possible.

articles.title: 芯片抽成从12.6元涨到434元！Arm和高通彻底翻脸
articles.text:
快科技10月21日消息，高通与Arm的授权诉讼10月20日进入结案陈词，法庭上首次公开了Arm提出的Armv10授权费率，按一颗售价220美元（快科技注：约1469元人民币）的骁龙旗舰芯片计算，Arm要抽走12.8%到29.5%。
换算成钱就是每颗28.16到64.9美元（快科技注：约188元到434元人民币），而高通现在交多少呢？
双方2013年签的架构授权协议有效期到2033年，规定五核以上的芯片授权费上限为每颗1.88美元（快科技注：约12.6元人民币）。
这1.88美元按150美元的计价基数算相当于1.25%，按220美元的实际售价算只有0.85%。
倍数因此相当吓人，高通代理律师Karen Dunn说，Arm的v10报价最高能到现在的15倍，她还引用了一份封存的专家测算，2034至2040年的费率是现在的34.5倍，套到1.88美元这个上限上，就是2027至2033年每颗28.20美元、2034至2040年每颗64.86美元。
Arm这边的理由是2013年的条款太老了，Arm代理律师Gregg LoCascio在庭上说：“今天是220，是2013年某些价格的十倍。”意思是当年设定的封顶早就跟不上芯片涨价的幅度。
他还透露v10的费率部分参考了谷歌和微软付的钱，并质疑一份为小尺寸手机芯片设的上限，凭什么也适用于288核的数据中心处理器。
中间还插了一段没谈成的和解，LoCascio说高通2024年底曾提出预付2.5亿美元（快科技注：约16.7亿元人民币）换取v10条款并了结诉讼，Arm拒绝了。
作为对比，高通2013年签那份架构授权协议时只预付了4025万美元（快科技注：约2.69亿元人民币）。
法官Maryellen Noreika对高通要求法院强制双方重启谈判的诉求评价是“非常非常激进”，将在双方提交最终文件后以书面形式作出裁决。
需要说明的是，上面那些每颗芯片的具体金额，前提是把倍数直接乘在1.88美元这个上限上，Arm的v10真实结构并未公开，不同产品可能有不同算法。

articles.title: Intel、AMD在一起！联手简化x86 CPU AI开发
articles.text:
快科技10月21日消息，Intel与AMD联合宣布合作，将双方针对PyTorch的x86 CPU优化成果整合到开源深度学习库oneDNN中，减少x86 AI生态软件碎片化，简化PyTorch在x86系统上的开发部署。
oneDNN由统一加速基金会（UXL）管理，旨在提升AI工作负载在CPU上的运行效率。
根据x86生态系统顾问小组的建议，Intel和AMD已将oneDNN认定为PyTorch内x86加速的默认开源库。AMD正将自家的ZenDNN优化整合进oneDNN，并以指导委员会成员身份加入UXL基金会。
此前Intel有oneDNN，AMD有ZenDNN，两套独立优化路径迫使开发者针对不同CPU分别适配，增加了维护成本。
之后开发者通过oneDNN这个统一入口，即可获得面向Intel和AMD处理器的PyTorch CPU优化，在不同x86平台上获得更一致的开发体验。
双方还在AI计算扩展（AI Compute Extensions）方面展开合作，这是面向x86设计的下一代指令集架构，能够加速矩阵乘法，未来将通过oneDNN更新进一步集成至PyTorch中。

articles.title: AtomSD: Procedural Atom-Guided Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.26926v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) possess broad factual knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but solving complex tasks also requires procedural knowledge about how to act. Existing approaches often represent procedural knowledge through trajectories or bundled skills, limiting flexible reuse across interaction histories. This paper introduces Procedural Atoms, fine-grained and independently applicable units that represent Intent, When, Do, and Avoid guidance. Building on this representation, we propose AtomSD, an Atom-guided Self-Distillation framework in which the learner continually extracts Procedural Atoms from its own successful trajectories and distills them into the evolving policy through Atom-conditioned supervision and task-reward optimization. Comprehensive experiments show that AtomSD consistently outperforms strong reward-based and distillation methods, exceeding the state-of-the-art baseline by up to 9.31 points in average performance. Further analyses demonstrate that the proposed Procedural Atoms provide effective guidance, highlighting the value of atom-level procedural knowledge for policy learning.

articles.title: PHP曝出php2shell高危漏洞！腾讯云紧急提醒修复
articles.text:
快科技10月22日消息，日前，腾讯云发布PHP“php2shell”远程代码执行漏洞风险通告，披露PHP存在两个远程代码执行漏洞，编号分别为CVE-2026-109618和CVE-2026-109619，风险等级为高风险。
据介绍，攻击者无需身份验证，即可通过发送特制的multipart POST请求触发漏洞，造成内存破坏，最终实现远程代码执行，严重情况下可能导致服务器被完全控制。
具体来看，CVE-2026-109618与PHP处理内存耗尽（OOM）错误时的异常退出机制有关。
在特定情况下，内存分配失败可能导致请求内存处于无效状态，后续处理过程中进而引发内存破坏和远程代码执行。
另一个漏洞CVE-2026-109619则与PHP工作进程跨请求保留的全局状态有关。
由于部分状态未在请求内存释放前完全重置，后续请求可能访问已经失效的内存，进而引发释放后使用等内存安全问题，最终可能导致远程代码执行。
腾讯云指出，攻击者成功利用上述漏洞后，可以Web工作进程账户的身份执行任意代码，可能造成服务器完全沦陷、敏感数据泄露或恶意软件植入等后果。
在影响版本方面，腾讯云列出了以下存在漏洞的版本范围，并给出了对应的安全版本：
PHP 8.2：低于8.2.35的版本，建议升级至8.2.35或更高版本。
PHP 8.3：低于8.3.36的版本，建议升级至8.3.36或更高版本。
PHP 8.4：低于8.4.27的版本，建议升级至8.4.27或更高版本。
PHP 8.5：低于8.5.12的版本，建议升级至8.5.12或更高版本。
针对上述漏洞，腾讯云建议用户及时开展安全自查，评估业务是否受到影响，并尽快升级至对应安全版本。
升级前应做好数据备份，避免修复过程中出现意外。
此外，腾讯云表示，旗下腾讯T-Sec主机安全已支持相关漏洞检测，Web应用防火墙和云防火墙也已支持相应防护。
相关用户可通过PHP官方网站下载更新版本：https://www.php.net/downloads.php

articles.title: SITO: Sifting a Commercial Text-Safety API for Missed Harm and False Flags in English, Ukrainian and Surzhyk
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27178v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Platforms that host young users screen messages with commercial text-safety APIs, but independent evidence on how often such systems miss harm or flag harmless text is scarce, especially outside English, and the documentation of the one studied here leaves its false-positive rate unquantified. We evaluated one such API, Tuteliq Detect as deployed under the release identifier tuteliq-detect-v5.20261011 (not the separately published v6 model), on six harm categories: authorised push-payment fraud, money-mule recruitment, social engineering, romance scams, gambling harm and bullying. We built SITO (Synthetic Independent Text-safety benchmark with Overflagging tests; sito is Ukrainian for 'sieve'), 2,332 synthetic cases in English, Ukrainian and mixed Ukrainian, with each harmful case matched by hard harmless ones: same-topic messages, minimal-edit contrasts, warnings and retrospective accounts. On English text the system flagged 84.9-94.1% of harmful cases and 0-4.3% of harmless ones per category. It missed third-party reports of ongoing harm far more often than perpetrators' messages (63.6% against 95.1% recall, all languages), when sent without the settings the API offers for reports of harm. Ukrainian and mixed-language input was detected at least as often as English, recall was lower on text from a held-out generator family, so headline recall may be optimistic, and 3.2% of cases received a different decision in repeated runs. A platform should measure false positives on its own traffic and check how bystander reports are handled. The datasets, generation prompts and code are released.

articles.title: Hardware-backed security at global scale: Confidential G4 with NVIDIA Blackwell is GA
articles.text:
Bringing autonomous agents into production means processing sensitive data and valuable intellectual property in real time. Protecting proprietary model weights, user prompts, and generated outputs requires security that safeguards data while it is actively being computed.
As part of our efforts to enable your enterprise securely, today we are announcing that Confidential Computing on Google Cloud’s G4 instances enabled by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server edition GPUs is now generally available. This release integrates NVIDIA Confidential Computing directly into Google Cloud's AI Hypercomputer, delivering the dynamic performance needed to scale without compromising privacy.
When we announced Confidential G4 in preview earlier this year, we talked about its global footprint and scale. Today, these instances are generally available across 36 zones, using multiple consumption models, on Compute Engine VMs and GKE nodes.
In addition, support for Confidential Space enabling secure multi-party data sharing is rolling out to general availability in the coming weeks.
Protecting sensitive data and models at low latency
Protecting data in use shouldn't mean sacrificing GPU throughput or operational agility. By combining non-exportable hardware keys, verifiable remote attestation, and transparent memory encryption, Confidential G4 helps organizations maximize their investments in agentic and inference workloads. Enterprises can keep costs low while meeting strict regulatory and compliance requirements.
“As organizations deploy AI across increasingly complex cloud, on-premises, and agentic environments, protecting sensitive data is critical. Enterprises must also ensure that AI systems operate securely and consistently with their policies. Google Cloud Confidential G4 VMs powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs provide a powerful foundation for privacy-preserving AI and AI operations. Confidential Core AI builds on Google Cloud to transform enterprise principles, policies, and operating requirements into real-time safeguards that monitor and govern AI agents, models, data, and tools. Together, these capabilities enable organizations to scale trusted AI on Google Cloud while maintaining control, confidentiality, and accountability.” - Taher Behbehani, Founder and CEO, Confidential Core AI
Additional benefits for enterprise AI workloads include:
End-to-end confidentiality and isolation: Encrypt data and model parameters in hardware-enforced execution environments to shield intellectual property and customer inputs from host system administrators, hypervisors, and access by cloud providers.
Verifiable cryptographic trust: Use hardware-rooted remote attestation to verify code, platform configuration, and environment integrity before releasing sensitive datasets and running workloads.
No code refactoring: Deploy models out of the box using standard Ubuntu OS images, NVIDIA drivers, and NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries without application changes or custom builds.
For Polaris Cloud, this ease of deployment was transformational.
“Polaris builds workspaces for AI agents, and our customers need to know where an agent's work actually ran and that it was cryptographically isolated along the way. Google Cloud Confidential G4 has been a game changer for that. We get hardware-backed provenance from the NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, which we bind into the receipt customers get back with their results. Virtually nothing else changed: same G4 image, same NVIDIA driver, same container runtime, one flag at launch, same performance. Overnight it upgraded our customer promise from 'we run your agent' to 'every workload you run with us is verifiable.” - Fred Esere, Founder and CEO, Polaris Cloud
Multi-party data collaboration: Run collaborative analytics and joint model training securely using Confidential Space. Multiple parties can combine sensitive datasets without revealing underlying private data to each other.
“Enterprises need to put their most valuable data to work with AI while protecting it during processing. NVIDIA Confidential Computing brings hardware-backed protection to GPU-accelerated workloads, helping safeguard sensitive data and proprietary models while in use. Together with Google Cloud, we’re bringing NVIDIA Blackwell performance and these security capabilities to Confidential G4 VMs so organizations can scale production AI with high performance and verifiable protection.” - Dave Salvator, Director of Accelerated Computing Products, NVIDIA
Testing performance
To understand the operational impact of memory encryption, we analyzed Confidential G4 instances against standard, non-confidential G4 instances on the g4-standard-48 machine shape. Our testing focused on widely adopted open-weight models that customers frequently deploy on single-GPU instances for their own inference pipelines.
Benchmarking across popular models including Llama 3, Llama 3.3, Resnet-50, and SDXL shows that Confidential G4 delivers performance on par with standard G4 instances for AI inference workloads, with less than 3.5% degradation in throughput (measured in tokens or images per second).
Note: Performance results are based on specific testing conditions and configurations. Individual workload performance may vary based on system setup, hardware choice, and software environment.
Our analysis can help you move fast while protecting sensitive data and meeting compliance requirements — a trade-off that real-world deployments are already validating.
”We benchmarked Google Cloud's Confidential G4 against a standard G4 running identical software on our workloads. We found that for a modest 5.2% increase in end-to-end latency, we get a hardware-level assurance that ensures unauthorized users outside our users' attested environment cannot eavesdrop on their conversations. We'd make that trade every time; our users get the convenience of the cloud with the privacy of on-premises.” - Andy Qin, CEO, Vertebrae
Getting started with Confidential G4s
With Confidential G4, improving enterprise security during model execution and agentic workloads doesn't require sacrificing performance, flexibility, or operational simplicity. By providing verifiable trust and robust hardware isolation with near-zero throughput degradation, organizations can securely deploy high-value models and protect critical data assets at cloud scale.
Get started today by following the Confidential VM with GPU documentation.

articles.title: ICLHerd: Herding-Based Data Selection for LLMs with In-Context Learning as a Proxy
articles.text:
arXiv:2610.27142v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Data selection plays a central role in modern large language model training, as the quality of training data strongly influences downstream performance. A common approach is to curate a development set that encodes the desired skills (e.g., reasoning or multilinguality) and select data that are similar to them. Existing methods compute similarity using cosine distance over either the model's hidden states or gradients. However, we observe that this max-similarity strategy induces a mode-seeking bias: the selected data clusters tightly around the development samples. To address this, we propose ICLHerd, a data selection framework that leverages the von Mises-Fisher kernel to balance mode-seeking with mode-averaging. We further introduce in-context learning as a validation proxy, enabling efficient hyperparameter search over the balance trade-off. Results show that ICLHerd outperforms existing LLM data selection algorithms, highlighting the importance of balancing mode-seeking and mode-averaging.
